learning_outcomes.text: Defines differential equations, knows the concepts of order, degree, and linearity, and derives the differential equation for a family of curves.
Solves differential equations using power series.
Solves differential equations using Laplace transform.
Solves systems of differential equations using specific methods.
Recognizes and solves certain types of variable-coefficient differential equations.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and classification of differential equations
Differential equations reducible to linear form
General solution of higher-order linear homogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients
General solution of higher-order linear non-homogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients (Method of undetermined coefficients, Variation of parameters method, Operator method)
Finding the general solution of Euler differential equation
Order reduction method for differential equations
Solving differential equations using power series (Ordinary point, regular singular point, Method of undetermined coefficients and Frobenius method)
Inverse Laplace transform using partial fractions method
Solving linear differential equations with constant coefficients using Laplace transform
Application of the convolution theorem to integral equations
Laplace transform of the step function
Laplace transform of the impulse (Dirac) function
Solving homogeneous systems of differential equations
Derivation of homogeneous systems of differential equations by elimination method
Solving homogeneous systems of differential equations using the Eigen characteristic equation
Solving non-homogeneous systems of differential equations using the Eigen characteristic equation (Variation of parameters method of Lagrange constants)
assessment_rules: The overall success score is calculated as 50% from the midterm exam and 50% from the final exam.
